download_llama2_tokenizer: download the llama2 tokenizer model from HuggingFace hub to a local directory
download_llama3_tokenizer: download the llama3 tokenizer model from HuggingFace hub using an API key
download_gemma_tokenizer: download the gemma tokenizer model from Google on HuggingFace to a specified path
download_tiktoken_encoding: download a tiktoken encoding by name and cache it in the specified directory
run_tokenizer_download_cli: run the CLI to download a tokenizer by name to a target directory with optional API key
